items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of electric wheelchair
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20.11.2026 (posting day). Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery deemed on the 4th day after posting: 21.11 (Sat)=day1, 22.11 (Sun)=day2, 23.11 (Mon)=day3, 24.11 (Tue)=day4 → Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2026. Sender is a statutory Krankenkasse (social-law body, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), so the delivery day does not move even on a weekend/holiday (here it is a normal Tuesday anyway). One-month Widerspruch period per § 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X with §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of delivery (24.11) is not counted; the period ends on the day of the following month with the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 falls on a Saturday, so per § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB the period moves to the next working day: 25.12 (Sun, 1. Weihnachtstag) and 26.12 (Mon, 2. Weihnachtstag) are nationwide public holidays, so the next working day is Tue 27.12.2026.
